page_title: SHU 1-2 MCI | Sheffield Utd v Manchester City 27/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Jarred Gillett has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' The attendance for today's match is 31336.
90+7' Manchester City enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
90+4' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) takes the corner with a short pass.
90+2' Yasser Larouci (Sheffield Utd) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.

90+1' Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
88' 1 - 2 Rodri (Manchester City) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets inside the left post.
86' The substitution has been made. Phil Foden (Manchester City) has replaced Mateo Kovacic.
85' 1 - 1 Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort which ends up in the left side of the goal.
85' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) unleashes a long-range free kick, but the goalkeeper does well to make a fine save.
83' John Egan (Sheffield Utd) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jarred Gillett didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
82' Benie Traore (Sheffield Utd) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Chris Basham (Sheffield Utd) comes onto the pitch so that Oliver Norwood can be given a rest.
79' The resulting corner from Jack Grealish (Manchester City) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

79' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His effort heads for the left side of the goal, but Wesley Foderingham denies him. The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
78' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) sees a yellow card from Jarred Gillett after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
77' A dangerous towering header by Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the right post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
77' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
74' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
73' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
73' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
71' Paul Heckingbottom has decided to substitute William Osula and he is replaced by Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd).
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and George Baldock trots off the pitch and is replaced by Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd).
71' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Erling Haaland (Manchester City) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
70' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
68' The Manchester City players are exchanging some short passes.
66' Wesley Foderingham (Sheffield Utd) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
65' Wesley Foderingham (Sheffield Utd) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

63' 0 - 1 Goal! Jack Grealish swings the ball deep into the box and finds Erling Haaland (Manchester City) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper low into the middle of the goal. 0:1.
62' What a long-range shot by Kyle Walker (Manchester City). Unfortunately for him, his shot goes just a few inches over the bar.
62' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes a short corner kick.

62' A pass into the box finds Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the left side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Wesley Foderingham denies him. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
61' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

61' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Wesley Foderingham. Manchester City will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
59' William Osula (Sheffield Utd) is booked.
59' Rodri (Manchester City) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.
58' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) launches a cross from the corner, but Wesley Foderingham is alert to thwart the effort.

57' Ruben Dias (Manchester City) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Manchester City will take a corner kick.
55' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
55' A great run by Jack Grealish (Manchester City) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender.
54' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
53' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Manchester City.

51' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
49' That's a well-taken pass by Rodri (Manchester City). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.

48' What a poor attempt! Rodri (Manchester City) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
48' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
45+4' Jarred Gillett shows the yellow card to George Baldock (Sheffield Utd) for a heavy challenge.
45+4' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
45+4' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Julian Alvarez (Manchester City), but one of the defenders gets it clear. The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.

45+3' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Manchester City are going to take it.
45+1' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.

43' Rodri (Manchester City) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Wesley Foderingham!
41' Benie Traore (Sheffield Utd) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
37' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) fails to score from the penalty as his shot only hits the right post.
36' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is going to take the penalty!
35' Handball by John Egan (Sheffield Utd). Manchester City are awarded a penalty!
33' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
31' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar.

30' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul. Manchester City win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
29' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
28' Manchester City failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

28' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Wesley Foderingham. The ball is out of play. Manchester City win a corner kick.
27' The foul by William Osula (Sheffield Utd) was seen by Jarred Gillett who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
26' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
24' The ball possession at the moment is 16:84.
20' Nathan Ake (Manchester City) has a goal ruled out for offside!
20' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) will take the free kick.
19' Jarred Gillett blows for a foul after Benie Traore (Sheffield Utd) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Manchester City are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
17' Paul Heckingbottom is forced to make a change. Ben Osborn is unable to continue due to injury, Yasser Larouci (Sheffield Utd) comes on.
17' Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
16' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
14' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
14' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Manchester City.

13' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.

12' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Wesley Foderingham. This effort really didn't trouble him.
11' Rodri (Manchester City) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
9' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) misses a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball floats high over the crossbar!
6' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Bernardo Silva (Manchester City).
5' Ederson (Manchester City) sends a long ball forward to Bernardo Silva, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
2' The Manchester City players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Manchester City will take the kick-off.
Jarred Gillett was nominated as the referee for this game.
